This is a list of teachers of [[Nyaya]] (including ''[[Navya-Nyāya]]''), one of the six ''[[astika]]'' [[Hindu philosophy| Hindu philosophical]] systems.

# [[Ayachi Mishra]]

# [[Vasudeva Sarvabhauma|Vāsudeva Sārvabhauma]]
# Padmanābha Miśra

# Rambhadra Sārvabhauma
# Haridas Bhattacharya
# Mathuranath Tarkavagish
# Jagadish Tarkalankar

# Gadadhar Bhattacharya

# Viśvanātha

# Kalishankar Siddhantavagish (1781–1830)
# Golaknath Nyayaratna (1807–1855)
